desc: Disney Pixar Fruit Flavored Snacks feature gummy treats shaped like your favorite Disney Pixar characters for maximum fun. Packaged for on the go convenience and portability, these fruit flavored snacks are a treat the whole family can enjoy. They're handy for including in a packed school lunch box, or when you need a treat on a moment's notice. You've found the ideal after school snack that's a win for you and your kids. Beyond their great taste, these fruit flavored snacks contain no colors from artificial sources. They have an excellent source of vitamin C, and are gluten free and fat free, with 80 calories per serving. Contains one cardboard box of chewy Disney Pixar Fruit Flavored Snacks, Gummy Treat Pouches, Gluten Free Snack, 10 Ct, 8 oz.
features:
• GLUTEN FREE: They're made without colors from artificial sources and have an excellent source of vitamin C; Gluten free, fat free, and 80 calories per serving

• FROM SCREEN TO SNACK: Fruit flavored treats shaped like your favorite Disney Pixar characters for maximum fun
